environment.description: Same EC2 instance (c5.xlarge, Amazon Linux 2) running the identical binary, but deployed as a workload within an EKS cluster with Istio 1.19 service mesh. The pod runs in namespace 'legacy-monolith' with an Envoy sidecar injected (istio-proxy). An Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied at the namespace level with the following spec: action DENY for any source principal NOT matching 'cluster.local/ns/legacy-monolith/sa/*'. Additionally, a PeerAuthentication policy enforces STRICT mTLS for the namespace, meaning only workloads within the same namespace with valid SPIFFE identities issued by the mesh CA can establish connections. The /internal/sessions/invalidate path is further restricted by a second AuthorizationPolicy that requires the source to carry a request header 'x-internal-caller: session-manager' which is only injected by the session-manager sidecar filter within the same pod. External traffic or cross-namespace traffic is rejected at the Envoy proxy layer before reaching the application port.

config.binary_hardening: no ASAN, no jemalloc, default glibc allocator
